name: OB Quik Stop Liquor & OB Deli
notes: All 3 photos were legible menu boards/sheets. Photo 1 (wood specialty-sandwich board) and photo 3 (older blue paper specialty-sandwich sheet) share many of the same street-named sandwiches at different prices; kept the wood-board version for overlapping names and added the paper sheet's unique items (Muir Ave, Long Branch St, Niagara Ave, Ebers St, Abbott St, Narragansett Ave, BBQ x2). Photo 2 is the full deli board (breakfast/salads/regular sandwiches); its 'Extras' row is add-ons and was skipped.
